description: This file defines data structures and functions for parsing error messages related to invoked errors in an Android application, specifically handling error codes and messages with potential fallback mechanisms.

classes.name: ParsedInvokeError
classes.description: Data class representing a structured error with code, message, and an indicator if the code was explicitly provided.

methods.name: parseInvokeErrorMessage
methods.description: Parses a raw error string into a ParsedInvokeError object, extracting code and message if present.

methods.name: parseInvokeErrorFromThrowable
methods.description: Converts a Throwable object into a ParsedInvokeError, using its message or a fallback if the message is null or empty.
